verification_note: Prepared in 2026 for a listing requesting 2024-2025 information. Official documentation supports the capabilities and indicative allowances below; current pages are not archived proof of every historical price. Historical pricing uncertainty is explicitly marked check official pricing. No platform acceptance or payment is implied.

platforms.name: GitHub Actions
platforms.free_tier_notes: GitHub Free includes 2,000 minutes per month for private repositories; standard GitHub-hosted runners are free and unlimited for public repositories.
platforms.secret_management: GitHub Actions secrets and environment secrets are encrypted; self-hosted runners require additional operational controls.
platforms.best_for: Repositories hosted on GitHub that benefit from native pull-request checks and a large action ecosystem.
platforms.limitations: Strong coupling to GitHub; larger hosted runners and private-repository usage beyond the included quota are billable.
platforms.pricing_summary: Free standard hosted-runner usage for public repositories; 2,000 included minutes per month on GitHub Free for private repositories. For historical 2024-2025 terms or overage rates, check official pricing.

platforms.name: GitLab CI/CD
platforms.open_source_notes: The boolean refers to GitLab Community Edition under the MIT license, not every Enterprise Edition feature or the GitLab.com hosted service.
platforms.free_tier_notes: GitLab.com Free namespaces receive 400 compute minutes per month; self-managed runners use the operator's own infrastructure.
platforms.secret_management: Masked and protected CI/CD variables, file variables, and external secrets integrations.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an integrated source-control, CI/CD, registry, security, and deployment platform with a self-managed option.
platforms.limitations: The integrated feature set can be operationally heavy; GitLab.com compute quotas and runner cost factors require monitoring.
platforms.pricing_summary: The reviewed official documentation lists 400 monthly compute minutes on GitLab.com Free; self-managed capacity is customer-funded. For historical 2024-2025 terms, check official pricing.

platforms.name: CircleCI
platforms.free_tier_notes: Up to 6,000 monthly build minutes is advertised in an official article updated May 8, 2025. The reviewed pricing page lists 30,000 credits per month; effective minutes depend on resource credit rates, so 6,000 is not a universal allowance for every executor.
platforms.secret_management: Project environment variables and reusable contexts with access restrictions.
platforms.best_for: Cloud-first teams needing mature test parallelism, matrix jobs, reusable orbs, and several hosted execution environments.
platforms.limitations: Credit-based billing makes minute comparisons resource-dependent; the Free plan limits active users and included storage/network transfer.
platforms.pricing_summary: Official 2025 material advertises up to 6,000 free monthly build minutes; reviewed pricing uses credits rather than a universal minute quota. For exact historical credit rates and limits, check official pricing.

platforms.name: Jenkins
platforms.free_tier_notes: Jenkins is free open-source self-hosted software with no vendor minute quota; usable capacity is limited by the infrastructure and agents supplied by the operator.
platforms.secret_management: Jenkins Credentials store, Credentials Binding plugin, and compatible external secret providers.
platforms.best_for: Organizations needing maximum on-premises control, extensive plugin coverage, and highly customized heterogeneous build farms.
platforms.limitations: The operator owns controller security, upgrades, backups, plugin compatibility, capacity planning, and infrastructure cost.
platforms.pricing_summary: No Jenkins software license or minute charge; hosting, administration, support, and build-agent infrastructure remain customer costs.

platforms.name: Drone CI
platforms.open_source_notes: The boolean refers to Drone Community Edition; Enterprise Edition includes proprietary code and must be assessed separately.
platforms.free_tier_notes: Drone Community Edition is open-source and self-hosted with no hosted minute quota; effective capacity and cost depend on operator-managed runners.
platforms.matrix_builds_notes: Matrix-like combinations can be generated as multiple pipelines with Starlark or Jsonnet. This does not assert that modern Drone YAML has the native matrix keyword documented for legacy Drone 0.8; Starlark support must be enabled by the server administrator.
platforms.secret_management: Repository and organization secrets, runner-level secrets, and external secret extensions such as Vault.
platforms.best_for: Container-native self-hosted pipelines where small configuration files and isolated Docker execution are priorities.
platforms.limitations: Community and enterprise feature boundaries must be checked; matrix behavior and generated configuration can vary by Drone version.
platforms.pricing_summary: Community Edition is self-hosted open-source software without a minute quota; infrastructure and any enterprise subscription are separate costs.
